description: Deterministic canary checks for SkillOpt candidate harness-builder skill documents.

cases.prompt: Verify the candidate remains discoverable as the harness-builder skill.
cases.expected_behavior: The candidate keeps YAML frontmatter and the frontmatter name remains harness-builder.

cases.prompt: A project harness install is requested. Verify the skill preserves charter and user checkpoint gates before writing files.
cases.expected_behavior: The skill requires evidence, a Harness Charter, Coverage Matrix, and USER CHECKPOINT before installation.

tokens: Do not install on user silence

cases.prompt: Existing AGENTS.md and recovery surface must be reconciled. Verify thin entry and dynamic-state boundaries.
cases.expected_behavior: The skill keeps AGENTS.md thin and sends active state to the selected recovery surface.

tokens: Do not create a second recovery surface

cases.prompt: The agent may add hooks, MCP, subagents, CI, or skills as generic best practices. Verify capability fit rules.
cases.expected_behavior: The skill binds every capability to a named coverage gap and rejects unbound tools.

tokens: Add files or capabilities only when they close a named coverage gap
Bind every candidate capability to one coverage row
skills, hooks, MCP, subagents, external research, CI, GC
